t: DEWALT 18V 4.0Ah Li-Ion XR battery provides reliable power for cordless tools. Ideal battery for tradespeople requiring extended operation on job sites, such as electricians working with power tools or carpenters using saws and drills. It offers 33% improved run time and optimised power compared to the DEWALT 18V XR 3.0Ah version, ensuring longer work periods. A built-in fuel gauge allows for efficient monitoring of remaining charge. With almost no self-discharge, maximum energy is retained even after storage. Features the same lightweight design as the 3.0Ah battery, weighing 0.61kg, for comfortable use. The battery is compatible with all DEWALT 18V XR range power tools and the DEWALT universal XR charger.
